e3d40ecb7ce418fe9e5f641d2edecf3b1df36a41.english:
This enables emulation of the legacy vsyscall page.  Disabling
it is roughly equivalent to booting with vsyscall=none, except
that it will also disable the helpful warning if a program
tries to use a vsyscall.  With this option set to N, offending
programs will just segfault, citing addresses of the form
0xffffffffff600?00.
This option is required by many programs built before 2013, and
care should be used even with newer programs if set to N.
Disabling this option saves about 7K of kernel size and
possibly 4K of additional runtime pagetable memory.

translations.zh-CN:
这使人们能够模拟遗留的 vsyscall 页面。 残疾
它大致相当于 踢出Vsyscall=没有,除了。
如果程序, 也会禁用有用的警告
尝试使用阴道呼叫。 将这个选项设定为 N , 违法
程序将只是错误,引用表单的地址
0xffffffff600吗?
这一方案是2013年之前建立的许多程序所要求的。
如果设置为 N , 即使在新程序中使用时, 也应予以注意。
禁用此选项可保存大约 7K 个内核大小和
可能为4K 额外运行时间的分页存储器。

此选项可以检测不匹配的内存访问 。
对支持不匹配的架构启用此选项
访问可能会产生大量的假阳性.

ddfe39653e6e977f0e8151114393dcdfbc65c0b6.english:
This option enables detection of memory accesses via a
null pointer.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许通过 a 检测内存访问
无指针。

cedd0e37e05154cda17c6a33071ab8b0668b82fb.english: Compile the kernel with KASan: runtime memory debugger

7343c280789b5483e718ff3cdaa6d5d0c6c19ed1.english:
Enables kernel address sanitizer - runtime memory debugger,
designed to find out-of-bounds accesses and use-after-free bugs.
This is strictly a debugging feature and it requires a gcc version
of 4.9.2 or later. Detection of out of bounds accesses to stack or
global variables requires gcc 5.0 or later.
This feature consumes about 1/8 of available memory and brings about
~x3 performance slowdown.
For better error detection enable CONFIG_STACKTRACE.
Currently CONFIG_KASAN doesn't work with CONFIG_DEBUG_SLAB
(the resulting kernel does not boot).

translations.zh-CN:
启用内核地址消毒器 - 运行时内存调试器,
用于查找出界访问和无后用错误。
这纯粹是一个调试功能,需要 gcc 版本
4.9.2或以后各段。 检测到堆栈的出界权限或
全球变量需要 gcc 5.0 或以后。
这个功能消耗了大约1/8可用的内存,并带来了
~x3 性能减速.
为了更好地检测出错误,可以使用CONFIG_STACKTRACE.
目前CONFIG_KASAN不与CONFIG_DEBUG_SLAB合作.
(由此产生的内核不启动).

3d8f33c09b6778562f18652ea18c1e74135682b7.english:
This enables further checks in the kernel address sanitizer, for now
it only includes the address-use-after-scope check that can lead
to excessive kernel stack usage, frame size warnings and longer
compile time.
https://gcc.gnu.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=81715 has more

ede9ff58534b29b47ef629fa5c9dd79409c9b8e3.english:
Before every memory access compiler insert function call
__asan_load*/__asan_store*. These functions performs check
of shadow memory. This is slower than inline instrumentation,
however it doesn't bloat size of kernel's .text section so
much as inline does.

translations.zh-CN:
在每次内存访问编译器前插入函数调用
出道时间为:  asan load */ asan store *. 这些功能执行检查
影子记忆 这比内置仪表慢
不过它不是内核的... 文本部分的膨胀大小
就像内线一样

d43743ac743da9495efc904a70364c0cbe26cc5d.english:
Compiler directly inserts code checking shadow memory before
memory accesses. This is faster than outline (in some workloads
it gives about x2 boost over outline instrumentation), but
make kernel's .text size much bigger.
This requires a gcc version of 5.0 or later.

translations.zh-CN:
编译器直接插入代码检查阴影内存
内存访问。 速度快于大纲(一些工作量)
它比轮廓仪表有2个助推力 但是
使内核的文本大小大得多。
这需要gcc版本为5.0或更晚.

2a575b3363ad7520b4c6a012a0418b937d807ed7.english: Compile the kernel with code coverage for fuzzing

b09dc9bea6db2c538e3456aad0adf9d606fe1623.english:
KCOV exposes kernel code coverage information in a form suitable
for coverage-guided fuzzing (randomized testing).
If RANDOMIZE_BASE is enabled, PC values will not be stable across
different machines and across reboots. If you need stable PC values,
disable RANDOMIZE_BASE.
For more details, see Documentation/kcov.txt.

translations.zh-CN:
KCOV 以适合的形式曝光内核代码覆盖信息
用于覆盖制导模糊(随机测试)。
如果启用 RANDOMIZE  BASE, PC 值将不会在全局稳定
不同的机器和反弹 如果你需要稳定的PC值,
禁用 RANDOMIZE  BASE。
详情见Documents/kcov.txt.

8df22ea3d42f126f5e110e2c227beed3472fe531.english: Enable comparison operands collection by KCOV

bca7cd3501a3146f85961fb022c1a8543beadcb2.english:
KCOV also exposes operands of every comparison in the instrumented
code along with operand sizes and PCs of the comparison instructions.
These operands can be used by fuzzing engines to improve the quality
of fuzzing coverage.

translations.zh-CN:
KCOV还揭露了仪器中每个比较的操作
代码以及比较指令的操作大小和PC。
这些操作可以被模糊引擎用来提高质量
模糊的覆盖。

cdaaa72d8363e9c446288a31a4a7b1e16c32ded8.english:
If you are doing generic system call fuzzing (like e.g. syzkaller),
then you will want to instrument the whole kernel and you should
say y here. If you are doing more targeted fuzzing (like e.g.
filesystem fuzzing with AFL) then you will want to enable coverage
for more specific subsets of files, and should say n here.

translations.zh-CN:
如果你正在做通用系统调用模糊(例如: syzkaller),
那你会想把整个内核都装好,你应该
说你在这里。 如果你正在做更多的目标模糊(例如:
文件系统模糊与 AFL ) 那么您将想要启用覆盖
用于文件的更具体子集,并应在此表示 n。

c77ab53f9eaa4042eca1c1ba35141132dbd477cb.english: Compile the kernel with task resource/io statistics and accounting

9cc04f0c1b45476fec999163d078fab19ae62d70.english:
Enable the collection and publishing of task/io statistics and
accounting.  Enable this option to enable i/o monitoring in system
monitors.

translations.zh-CN:
能够收集和发布任务/io统计和
会计。 启用此选项以启用系统中的 i/o 监视
监视器。

fe5777fc1065001652bac66fa860e80daf2d3011.english: Compile the kernel with symbol table information

885676486637d480d7a287a3718da3b60bad811b.english: This will give you more information in stack traces from kernel oopses.

translations.zh-CN: 这将给你更多的信息 从内核 ops 的堆栈痕迹。

OpenWrt配置选项:函数配置器.

6118921bf887186e3f5b87efb9787bc5cb244ea9.english:
This option measures the time spent in irqs-off critical
sections, with microsecond accuracy.
The default measurement method is a maximum search, which is
disabled by default and can be runtime (re-)started
via:
echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_max_latency
(Note that kernel size and overhead increase with this option
enabled. This option and the preempt-off timing option can be
used together or separately.)

translations.zh-CN:
此选项衡量在irqs-off关键值中花费的时间
区域,带有微秒精确度。
默认测量方法为最大搜索,即
默认已禁用, 可以启动运行时间( 重起)
通过:
回声 0 > /sys/内核/调试/跟踪/跟踪 max lentency
(注意内核大小和间接费用随此选项而增加)
启用 。 此选项和先发制人的时间选项可以是
合并使用或单独使用。 )

dad9bc001c83bd93d4fd2e8b1dc6294e0932c6c3.english:
This option measures the time spent in preemption-off critical
sections, with microsecond accuracy.
The default measurement method is a maximum search, which is
disabled by default and can be runtime (re-)started
via:
echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_max_latency
(Note that kernel size and overhead increase with this option
enabled. This option and the irqs-off timing option can be
used together or separately.)

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可测量在先发制人的关键时间
区域,带有微秒精确度。
默认测量方法为最大搜索,即
默认已禁用, 可以启动运行时间( 重起)
通过:
回声 0 > /sys/内核/调试/跟踪/跟踪 max lentency
(注意内核大小和间接费用随此选项而增加)
启用 。 此选项和 irqs- off 计时选项可以是
合并使用或单独使用。 )

a2ef5523ae45814dbeab0fe8e008005fea86bd2c.english: This will compile your kernel and modules with debug information.

translations.zh-CN: 这将以调试信息编译您的内核和模块 。

62eb9fe7f7803b2eec3d666d3d7c65a170d728a5.english: Compile the kernel with dynamic printk

0792005cb77bfbd5875b22c6b7935229445f1043.english:
Compiles debug level messages into the kernel, which would not
otherwise be available at runtime. These messages can then be
enabled/disabled based on various levels of scope - per source file,
function, module, format string, and line number. This mechanism
implicitly compiles in all pr_debug() and dev_dbg() calls, which
enlarges the kernel text size by about 2%.

translations.zh-CN:
将调试关卡消息编译入内核, 而内核不会
否则可在运行时使用。 然后这些消息可以
基于不同范围――每个源文件,
函数、模块、格式字符串和行号。 该机制
在所有 pr  debug( ) 和 dev  dbg( ) 调用中默认编译
将内核文本大小扩大约2%。

94b2343615a12f8bce3a2558a11d39150d6a6600.english: Compile the kernel with early printk

7b4c33f7bb4fe029a9efe124168ce0ceb33df3e0.english:
Compile the kernel with early printk support.  This is only useful for
debugging purposes to send messages over the serial console in early boot.
Enable this to debug early boot problems.

translations.zh-CN:
以早期的平面支持来编译内核. 这只对
调试目的在早期启动时在串行控制台上发送消息 。
启用此功能以调试早期的启动问题 。

7bf0fc61c2e0f34ead45cfb6e300ed3e8efd1535.english: Compile the kernel with kprobes support

d59edbeb83fe51088dc523ebbfd44b96c10fbccf.english:
Compiles the kernel with KPROBES support, which allows you to trap
at almost any kernel address and execute a callback function.
register_kprobe() establishes a probepoint and specifies the
callback. Kprobes is useful for kernel debugging, non-intrusive
instrumentation and testing.
If in doubt, say "N".

translations.zh-CN:
在 KPROBES 支持下编译内核, 允许您陷阱
在几乎所有内核地址上执行调用函数。
注册  kprobe () 建立探测点并指定
调用。 Kprobes 可用于内核调试, 非侵入性
仪器和测试。
如果有疑问,就说"N".

ad412a64ce88c1dd0a1687bfb6502095666a47db.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with support for fhandle syscalls.

97554b06425f8d320373f621c5f3403531045109.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable kernel lock checking.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用内核锁检查.

cf6f8708b7c30e08b2b0a67a73c75c7ee71b1485.english: Compile the kernel with detect Soft Lockups

f9268a1d7de7237647e87ad1794326c8bd8a390e.english:
Say Y here to enable the kernel to act as a watchdog to detect
soft lockups.
Softlockups are bugs that cause the kernel to loop in kernel
mode for more than 20 seconds, without giving other tasks a
chance to run.  The current stack trace is displayed upon
detection and the system will stay locked up.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y让内核能充当监视者来侦测
软锁.
软锁是导致内核在内核中循环的错误
模式 20 秒以上,但不给其他任务 a
有机会逃跑 当前堆栈跟踪显示于
检测和系统会一直锁着

fa3052797899b322a72beae8f8d8563a62c2bae0.english: Compile the kernel with detect Hung Tasks

fa5e6a5337ca64215ec7186679f8c2cb05e32808.english:
Say Y here to enable the kernel to detect "hung tasks",
which are bugs that cause the task to be stuck in
uninterruptible "D" state indefinitely.
When a hung task is detected, the kernel will print the
current stack trace (which you should report), but the
task will stay in uninterruptible state. If lockdep is
enabled then all held locks will also be reported. This
feature has negligible overhead.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y在这里使内核能够检测"饥饿任务",
错误导致任务被卡入
无间断"D"状态无限.
当检测到挂起的任务时,内核会打印
当前堆栈跟踪( 您应该报告), 但是
任务将处于不间断状态。 如果锁定是
启用后, 所有锁定也会被报告 。 这个
特性具有可忽略不计的间接费用。

0d91b0e7b1c89bc266b9c7e7d94839047a940610.english: Compile the kernel with detect Workqueue Stalls

32594cff75d2c98e37cb68edba6788877c431f21.english:
Say Y here to enable stall detection on workqueues.  If a
worker pool doesn't make forward progress on a pending work
item for over a given amount of time, 30s by default, a
warning message is printed along with dump of workqueue
state.  This can be configured through kernel parameter
"workqueue.watchdog_thresh" and its sysfs counterpart.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y在这里允许 摊位检测在工作井。 如果有的话
工人队伍在未完成的工作方面没有取得进展
30s 默认, a
警告信息会同时被打印 。
状态。 可以通过内核参数配置此选项
"Workqueue.watchdog thresh"和它的sysfs对应.

03572af1b5b38f73a6eb73393dff108ba8a3b6a7.english: Compile the kernel with sleep inside atomic section checking

2fdfc81fba06b2fa570d87e791eba30f04306a9a.english:

noisy if they are called inside atomic sections: when a spinlock is
held, inside an rcu read side critical section, inside preempt disabled
sections, inside an interrupt, etc...

translations.zh-CN:
如果你在这里说Y, 各种例行公事 可能会成为非常
如果它们被称作原子部分, 声音就会响起: 当一个自旋锁是
在 rcu 读取侧键部分内, 预置已禁用
部分,在中断中,等等...

如果不确定,请说N.

devtmpfs是一个简单,内核管理的/dev文件系统. 内核创建

c5ff0751cac7aca060dc57f1b30964ac30ec0cb5.english:

6f5c497b4c161303115a5a6b6e16fecbcb378993.english: Memory Resource Controller for Control Groups

58740a28ea9af35a53f26a3c84becc0699808823.english:
Provides a memory resource controller that manages both anonymous
memory and page cache. (See Documentation/cgroups/memory.txt)
Note that setting this option increases fixed memory overhead
associated with each page of memory in the system. By this,
20(40)bytes/PAGE_SIZE on 32(64)bit system will be occupied by memory
usage tracking struct at boot. Total amount of this is printed out
at boot.
Only enable when you're ok with these tradeoffs and really
sure you need the memory resource controller. Even when you enable
this, you can set "cgroup_disable=memory" at your boot option to
disable memory resource controller and you can avoid overheads
(but lose benefits of memory resource controller).
This config option also selects MM_OWNER config option, which
could in turn add some fork/exit overhead.

translations.zh-CN:
提供管理两种匿名的内存资源控制器
内存和页面缓存。 (见文件/小组/备忘录.txt)
注意设置此选项会增加固定内存的间接费用
与系统内存的每页相关。 通过这个
20(40)字节/PAGE SIZE 在32(64)bit系统中将被内存占用
使用跟踪脚步。 打印总数
在靴子上。
只有在你同意这些取舍的时候 才能进行
您确定需要内存资源控制器 。 即使你允许
您可以在您的启动选项中设置“ cgroup  disable=memory ” 。
禁用内存资源控制器并可以避免管理费用
(但丧失了内存资源控制器的好处).
此配置选项还选择了 MM  OWNER 配置选项, 该选项
反过来,还可以增加一些叉子/出站费。

015b44f90470a448ab11e5115ecec3f53b17d069.english:
Add swap management feature to memory resource controller. When you
enable this, you can limit mem+swap usage per cgroup. In other words,
when you disable this, memory resource controller has no cares to
usage of swap...a process can exhaust all of the swap. This extension
is useful when you want to avoid exhaustion swap but this itself
adds more overheads and consumes memory for remembering information.
Especially if you use 32bit system or small memory system, please
be careful about enabling this. When memory resource controller
is disabled by boot option, this will be automatically disabled and
there will be no overhead from this. Even when you set this config=y,
if boot option "swapaccount=0" is set, swap will not be accounted.
Now, memory usage of swap_cgroup is 2 bytes per entry. If swap page
size is 4096bytes, 512k per 1Gbytes of swap.

translations.zh-CN:
在内存资源控制器中添加互换管理功能. 当你
启用此选项, 您可以限制每组的 mem+ swap 使用 。 换句话说
当您禁用此选项时, 内存资源控制器将不关心
使用交换... 一个过程可以用尽所有的交换。 此扩展名
当您想要避免耗尽交换时有用, 但这本身
增加了更多的间接费用,并消耗了记忆中的信息.
特别是如果您使用 32bit 系统或小型内存系统, 请
要小心让这。 当内存资源控制器
按启动选项禁用,此选项将自动禁用,
不会有任何间接费用。 即使你设定了这个配置
如果设置了“ swapcount=0” 的启动选项,则互换将不予核算。
现在,switch cgroup的内存使用为每个条目2字节. 如果互换页面
大小为4096字节,每1G字节互换512k.

cd1ca76b4c839103e260e465afd9dffd070550eb.english: Memory Resource Controller Swap Extension enabled by default

704147501c17256dc6638948a221a9ab5bf23da9.english:
Memory Resource Controller Swap Extension comes with its price in
a bigger memory consumption. General purpose distribution kernels
which want to enable the feature but keep it disabled by default
and let the user enable it by swapaccount boot command line
parameter should have this option unselected.
Those who want to have the feature enabled by default should
select this option (if, for some reason, they need to disable it,
then swapaccount=0 does the trick).

translations.zh-CN:
内存资源控制器交换扩展名, 其价格为
更大的记忆消耗。 普通用途分配内核
想要启用该特性但默认保留其禁用
让用户通过互换账户启动命令行启用
参数应当未选择此选项。
默认想要启用该特性的人应当
选择此选项( 如果出于某种原因, 他们需要禁用它,
然后交换账户=0做诡计。

97df1c235bc052638fa2d02524cb1a8a9751e019.english: Memory Resource Controller Kernel Memory accounting (EXPERIMENTAL)

14dbfc43412aefad32cd0e5bf7ef3ed0a07480ed.english:
The Kernel Memory extension for Memory Resource Controller can limit
the amount of memory used by kernel objects in the system. Those are
fundamentally different from the entities handled by the standard
Memory Controller, which are page-based, and can be swapped. Users of
the kmem extension can use it to guarantee that no group of processes
will ever exhaust kernel resources alone.

translations.zh-CN:
内存资源控制器的内存扩展可以限制
系统内核对象使用的内存量。 这些是
与标准处理的实体根本不同
内存控制器,它基于页面,可以互换. 用户
kmem 扩展可以用来保证任何一组过程
只有内核资源才会耗尽

a70903d6a7f73df3912f945f573acf552ada7c20.english:

b645ef1262599542c85204abed161dc9ad75daa0.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Group scheduling for SCHED_OTHER.

06417d7327ca2892cccbf790701f832c98686121.english:

tasks running within the fair group scheduler.  Groups with no limit

restriction.
See tip/Documentation/scheduler/sched-bwc.txt for more information.

6e8bc689b968d4eb6baee0e66a9089e3e98ba6f9.english:
This feature lets you explicitly allocate real CPU bandwidth
to task groups. If enabled, it will also make it impossible to
schedule realtime tasks for non-root users until you allocate
realtime bandwidth for them.

translations.zh-CN:
此特性允许您明确分配真实的 CPU 带宽
改为任务组。 如果启用, 也会导致无法
为非根用户安排实时任务直至分配
他们的实时带宽。

763ea379be07929867104c33134f25c707d4893e.english:
Generic block IO controller cgroup interface. This is the common
cgroup interface which should be used by various IO controlling
policies.
Currently, CFQ IO scheduler uses it to recognize task groups and
control disk bandwidth allocation (proportional time slice allocation)
to such task groups. It is also used by bio throttling logic in
block layer to implement upper limit in IO rates on a device.
This option only enables generic Block IO controller infrastructure.
One needs to also enable actual IO controlling logic/policy. For
enabling proportional weight division of disk bandwidth in CFQ, set
CONFIG_CFQ_GROUP_IOSCHED=y; for enabling throttling policy, set
CONFIG_BLK_DEV_THROTTLING=y.

translations.zh-CN:
通用块 IO 控制器 cgroup 接口. 这是常见的
c组界面, 用于各种 IO 控制
政策。
目前,CFQ IO排程器使用它来识别任务组和
控制磁盘带宽分配(按比例的时间切片分配)
向这些工作组提出。 生物减速逻辑也用于
块层以在设备上执行IO速率的上限。
此选项只允许通用的 Block IO 控制器基础设施 。
还需要实现实际的IO控制逻辑/政策. 对于
允许 CFQ 中磁盘带宽的比例分量, 设定
CONFIG_CFQ_GROUP_IOSCHED=y; 用于启用节流政策, 设置
(原始内容存档于2018-10-21). CONFIG_BLK_DEV_THROTTLING=y.

(原始内容存档于2018-10-26). pid namespaces. 这是一组集装箱

d5af3d1aa0df0bbbf07659087732a0b2f2c05ab1.english:
Enable support for multiple instances of devpts filesystem.
If you want to have isolated PTY namespaces (eg: in containers),
say Y here. Otherwise, say N. If enabled, each mount of devpts
filesystem with the '-o newinstance' option will create an
independent PTY namespace.

translations.zh-CN:
为多例devpts文件系统启用支持 。
如果您想要隔离 PTY 命名空间( 如: 在容器中) ,
在这里说Y。 否则,说N. 如果启用, 则每个已挂载的 devpts
带有“ -o newinstance” 选项的文件系统将创建一个
独立 PTY 命名空间 。

555a4b0538cabbae9f864472b0418670a73cbea0.english:
POSIX variant of message queues is a part of IPC. In POSIX message
queues every message has a priority which decides about succession
of receiving it by a process. If you want to compile and run
programs written e.g. for Solaris with use of its POSIX message
queues (functions mq_*) say Y here.
POSIX message queues are visible as a filesystem called 'mqueue'
and can be mounted somewhere if you want to do filesystem
operations on message queues.

translations.zh-CN:
消息队列的POSIX变体是IPC的一部分. 在 POSIX 信件中
队列每个消息都有决定继承的优先权
通过一个过程得到它。 如果你想编译和运行
使用 POSIX 消息为 Solaris 编写的程序
队列( 函数 mqQQQ) 这里说 Y 。
POSIX 消息队列作为名为“ mqueue”的文件系统可见
并可以挂载到某个地方,如果您想要执行文件系统
在信件队列上操作。

a4edc4861cd76711dece35ed071e8998c2e5df2f.english: The SELinux Reference Policy project (refpolicy) is a complete SELinux policy that can be used as the system policy for a variety of systems and used as the basis for creating other policies. Reference Policy was originally based on the NSA example policy, but aims to accomplish many additional goals. The current refpolicy does not fully support OpenWRT and needs modifications to work with the default system file layout. These changes should be added as patches to the refpolicy that modify a single SELinux policy. The refpolicy works for the most part in permissive mode. Only the basic set of utilities are enabled in the example policy config and some of the pathing in the policies is not correct.  Individual policies would need to be tweaked to get everything functioning properly.

translations.zh-CN: SELinux参考政策项目(refpolicy)是一个完整的SELinux政策,可以用作各种系统的系统政策并用作创建其他政策的基础. 参考政策最初基于消极安全保证的范例政策,但旨在实现许多额外目标。 当前refpolicy并不完全支持OpenWRT,需要修改以配合默认系统文件布局. 这些修改应作为修改单一SELinux政策的Refpolicy的补丁来添加. 调整政策在多数情况下是允许的。 在实例政策配置中,只有一套基本公用事业被启用,政策中的一些路径并不正确。 需要调整个别政策,使一切正常运转。

663918344242cd9941445f97d58645470336ac19.english: urngd is OpenWrt's micro non-physical true random number generator based on timing jitter. Using the Jitter RNG core, the rngd provides an entropy source that feeds into the Linux /dev/random device if its entropy runs low. It updates the /dev/random entropy estimator such that the newly provided entropy unblocks /dev/random. The seeding of /dev/random also ensures that /dev/urandom benefits from entropy. Especially during boot time, when the entropy of Linux is low, the Jitter RNGd provides a source of sufficient entropy.

translations.zh-CN: urngd是OpenWrt的微非物理真实的随机数生成器,基于计时快克. 使用Jitter RNG核心,rngd提供了一个 en源,如果它的 en能运行得低,则会被喂入Linux /dev/random设备. 它更新了 /dev/random Entropy 估计器,这样新提供的 Entropy 解锁 /dev/random 。 /dev/random的播种也确保了/dev/urandom从 en得到好处. 特别是在靴子时间,当Linux的 en值较低时,Jitter RNGd提供了足够 en值的来源.

848b1296f6a358f6fc520c6ef8ab0363a0ebd499.english: Atop is an ASCII full-screen performance monitor for Linux that is capable of reporting the activity of all processes (even if processes have finished during the interval), daily logging of system and process activity for long-term analysis, highlighting overloaded system resources by using colors, etcetera. At regular intervals, it shows system-level activity related to the CPU, memory, swap, disks (including LVM) and network layers, and for every process (and thread) it shows e.g. the CPU utilization, memory growth, disk utilization, priority, username, state, and exit code. In combination with the optional kernel module netatop, it even shows network activity per process/thread.

translations.zh-CN: Atop是Linux的ASCII全屏性能显示器,能够报告所有进程的活动(即使进程在间隔期间已经完成),日常记录系统和进程活动进行长期分析,通过使用颜色等来突出超载系统资源. 它定期显示与CPU,内存,互换,磁盘(包括LVM)和网络层相关的系统级活性,并显示每个进程(和线程),例如CPU的利用率,内存增长,磁盘利用率,优先级,用户名,状态,以及退出代码等. 它与可选内核模块netatop结合,甚至显示每个进程/线程的网络活性.

0a34ec4f3b3573eedf35e341ed5ddca9f4899ca1.english: The daemon netatopd is packaged with the netatop kernel module. This daemon takes care that information is gathered about processes that are finished. For every finished process that has transferred network packets, a binary record is written to a dedicated logfile. The added records in the logfile are read by atop with every sample to show information about the network activity of finished processes as well.

translations.zh-CN: 守护进程网顶由网顶内核模块来包装. 此守护进程会注意收集已完成进程的信息 。 对于每一个已传输网络包的完成进程,一个二进制记录会被写入一个专用日志文件. 日志文件中增加的记录由Atop阅读,每个样本都显示已完成进程的网络活动信息。

716cf4e5041f933ee0476c6c7c39a12f292741eb.english: Netfilter (IPv4/IPv6) module for matching cluster This option allows you to build work-load-sharing clusters of network servers/stateful firewalls without having a dedicated load-balancing router/server/switch. Basically, this match returns true when the packet must be handled by this cluster node. Thus, all nodes see all packets and this match decides which node handles what packets. The work-load sharing algorithm is based on source address hashing. This module is usable for ipv4 and ipv6. To use it also enable iptables-mod-cluster see `iptables -m cluster --help` for more information.

translations.zh-CN: 网络过滤器( IPv4/ IPv6) 模块, 用于匹配集群 此选项允许您在没有专用负载平衡路由器/ 服务器/ 开关的情况下构建网络服务器/ 状态防火墙的工作负载共享集群 。 基本上, 当数据包必须由这个集群节点处理时, 此匹配返回为真实 。 因此,所有节点都能看到所有的数据包,这个匹配决定了哪个节点处理什么数据包. 工作负荷共享算法基于源地址散列. 这个模块可用于ipv4和ipv6. 要使用它,还可以使用 iptables-mod-cluster 见`iptables -m cluster --help` 获取更多信息.

As soon as atop discovers that this module is active, it shows the columns SNET and RNET in the generic screen for the number of transmitted and received packets per process. When the 'n' key is pressed, it shows detailed counters about the number packets transmitted/received via TCP and UDP, the average sizes of these packets, and the total bandwidth consumed for input and output per process/thread.

16a05ec7792991330db7239ab1ca3af46b780340.english: B.A.T.M.A.N. (better approach to mobile ad-hoc networking) is a routing protocol for multi-hop ad-hoc mesh networks. The networks may be wired or wireless. See https://www.open-mesh.org/ for more information and user space tools. This package builds version 2021.1 of the kernel module.

translations.zh-CN: B.A.T.M.A.N.(移动相控网络的更好方式)是多跳相控网的路由协议. 网络可以是有线或无线的。 更多信息和用户空间工具请参见https://www.open-mesh.org/. 这个软件包构建了内核模块的202.1.1版本.

e23176bbc44e3f220bf8f7834c85b8cc8618d617.english:
This option enables the B.A.T.M.A.N. V protocol, the successor
of the currently used B.A.T.M.A.N. IV protocol. The main
changes include splitting of the OGM protocol into a neighbor
discovery protocol (Echo Location Protocol, ELP) and a new OGM
Protocol OGMv2 for flooding protocol information through the
network, as well as a throughput based metric.
B.A.T.M.A.N. V is currently considered experimental and not
compatible to B.A.T.M.A.N. IV networks.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可实现B.A.T.M.A.N.V.协议,后续协议
目前使用的B.A.T.M.A.N.IV.协议。 主语
更改包括 OGM 协议拆分为邻
发现协议(Echo Location Protocol,ELP)和一个新的OGM
《关于通过
网络,以及基于吞吐量的衡量标准。
B.A.T.M.A.N.V.目前被认为是实验性的,而不是
兼容B.A.T.M.A.N.IV网络。

7b59c1d40b50f90d9253ffca8e5b93b9a1b332c4.english:
This option enables BLA (Bridge Loop Avoidance), a mechanism
to avoid Ethernet frames looping when mesh nodes are connected
to both the same LAN and the same mesh. If you will never use
more than one mesh node in the same LAN, you can safely remove
this feature and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许 BLA( Bridge 循环避免), 一种机制
以避免网格节点连接时以太网框架循环
同一局域网和网格 如果你永远不会使用
在同一局域网中一个以上的网点,可以安全取出
此特性并保存一些空间。

8a569718b0c37c632a7502bee447211cb0ab988b.english:
This option enables DAT (Distributed ARP Table), a DHT based
mechanism that increases ARP reliability on sparse wireless
mesh networks. If you think that your network does not need
this option you can safely remove it and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许基于 DHT 的 DAT( 分布式 ARP 表)
增加稀有无线的ARP可靠性的机制
网易网. 如果你认为你的网络不需要
此选项可以安全取出并保存一些空间。

4748ae3338020848aa10e43be9353770f4b3a904.english:
This option enables network coding, a mechanism that aims to
increase the overall network throughput by fusing multiple
packets in one transmission.
Note that interfaces controlled by batman-adv must be manually
configured to have promiscuous mode enabled in order to make
network coding work.
If you think that your network does not need this feature you
can safely disable it and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可启用网络编码, 这种机制旨在
通过多引信来增加整个网络的通量
包在一个传输。
注意由 Batman-adv 控制的接口必须是手动的
配置以启用乱期模式以制作
网络编码工作.
如果你觉得你的网络不需要这个功能
可以安全地禁用它并保存一些空间。

c760aa40dd87fd0db2e8eff97ef9fef372d2474d.english:
This option enables the multicast optimisation which aims to
reduce the air overhead while improving the reliability of
multicast messages.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许多播优化, 目的是
减少空中高空飞行,同时提高
多广播消息。

9d5d61cd03f6a6fe5268fdc685ae23d22bd77be9.english:
This is an option for use by developers; most people should
say N here. This enables compilation of support for
outputting debugging information to the debugfs log or tracing
buffer. The output is controlled via the batadv netdev specific
log_level setting.

translations.zh-CN:
这是一个供开发者使用的选项; 大多数人应该

dbe7e57372a6ac4d35e289602c2de43eaaadb3cb.english:
This option will enable debug tracing output for the iwlwifi drivers
This will result in the kernel module being ~100k larger.  You can
control which debug output is sent to the kernel log by setting the
value in
/sys/module/iwlwifi/parameters/debug
This entry will only exist if this option is enabled.
To set a value, simply echo an 8-byte hex value to the same file:
% echo 0x43fff > /sys/module/iwlwifi/parameters/debug
You can find the list of debug mask values in:
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/iwl-debug.h
If this is your first time using this driver, you should say Y here
as the debug information can assist others in helping you resolve
any problems you may encounter.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项将启用 iwlwifi 驱动程序调试跟踪输出
这将导致内核模块的大小为~100k. 你们可以
通过设置调试输出到内核日志的控制
数值在
/sys/module/iwlwifi/参数/调试
此条目只有在启用此选项时才会存在 。
要设置值, 只需对同一文件的 8 字节六进制值进行回声 :
%回声 0x43fff > /sys/module/iwlwifi/参数/调试
您可以在 :
驱动/网/无线/英特尔/iwlwifi/iwl-debug.h
如果这是你第一次使用这个司机, 你应该说Y在这里
由于调试信息可以帮助其他人帮助您解决
遇到任何问题

54c2bc295a03731ed66976bfbe760486e04c558c.english: This is an alternative driver for various Realtek RTL8XXX parts written to utilize the Linux mac80211 stack. The driver is known to work with a number of RTL8723AU, RL8188CU, RTL8188RU, RTL8191CU, and RTL8192CU devices This driver is under development and has a limited feature set. In particular it does not yet support 40MHz channels and power management. However it should have a smaller memory footprint than the vendor drivers and benetifs from the in kernel mac80211 stack. It can coexist with drivers from drivers/staging/rtl8723au, drivers/staging/rtl8192u, and drivers/net/wireless/rtlwifi, but you will need to control which module you wish to load. RTL8XXXU_UNTESTED is enabled This option enables detection of Realtek 8723/8188/8191/8192 WiFi USB devices which have not been tested directly by the driver author or reported to be working by third parties. Please report your results!

translations.zh-CN: 这是为使用 Linux mac80211 堆栈而撰写的各种 Realtek RTL8XXX 部件的替代驱动程序 。 据了解,司机与若干RTL8723AU、RL8188CU、RTL8188RU、RTL8191CU和RTL8192CU设备一起工作。 这个驱动程序正在开发中,并有一个有限的功能集. 它尤其不支持40MHz频道和电力管理. 然而,它的内存足迹应该比销售商司机和从内核mac80211堆起的贝涅菲斯要小. 它可以与司机/stage/rtl8723au,司机/stage/rtl8192u,以及司机/net/无线/rtlwifi并存,但需要控制您希望加载的哪个模块. 已启用 RTL8XXXU UNTESTED 这个选项能够检测Realtek 8723/8188/8191/8192 WiFi USB设备,这些设备未经驱动程序作者直接测试或报告第三方正在工作. 请报告结果!

3eb552eaaa0ab6c274ec4609cebd4f069192a518.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS library.

translations.zh-CN: OWFS是一套旨在使一线总线及其装置易于取用的程序. 其根本原则是创建虚拟文件系统,以独有的ID为目录,设备的单个属性被作为简单的文件来表示,可以读取并写出. 单个奴隶或主设计的细节被隐藏在一个一致的界面后. 目标是为软件设计师创建监测或控制应用程序提供一套简单的工具. 实施中有一些性能增强,包括数据缓存,平行访问总线主机,以及设备通信的汇总. 资金的目标仍然是便于使用、灵活和正确,而不是速度。 此包包含 OWFS 库 。

7d524c074963da710d28b0e718c43de46b2485ca.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS C-API library.

818a0e54839ca2580a3258e423ab1db766da1773.english: Fwknop implements an authorization scheme known as Single Packet Authorization (SPA) for Linux systems running iptables.  This mechanism requires only a single encrypted and non-replayed packet to communicate various pieces of information including desired access through an iptables policy. The main application of this program is to use iptables in a default-drop stance to protect services such as SSH with an additional layer of security in order to make the exploitation of vulnerabilities (both 0-day and unpatched code) much more difficult. This package contains the libfko shared library.

removing outdated algorithms, and encrypting more of the
protocol;

when performing a full handshake.
It increases package size by ~4KB.

d27704ef13075d30ec7a33f5e6abbfa55716b325.english:

(IV).  At least one driver does not update the IV as a workaround
for DMA issues.  With this option turned on, the engine will keep
track of the counter, and the IV will be sent with every update.
If fallback is enabled, then the counter needs to be updated by
the engine anyway, and sent with the request everytime there's a
switch from software to hardware, so this won't bring much gain in
that case.

不要靠内核驱动程序更新 CTR 模式计数器
页:1 至少有一个驱动程序不更新 IV 是一个工作轮
就DMA问题而言 此选项启用后, 引擎将保留
计数器的音轨,四号将随每次更新一起被发送.
如果启用倒计时器, 则需要通过
无论如何,引擎,并随请求发送 每次有一个
从软件切换到硬件,这样不会带来什么好处

6af4a7e75866c6cc5351c44a0ca2f91655f6c909.english: libConfuse is a configuration file parser library, licensed under the terms of the ISC license, and written in C. It supports sections and (lists of) values (strings, integers, floats, booleans or other sections), as well as some other features (such as single/double-quoted strings, environment variable expansion, functions and nested include statements). It makes it very easy to add configuration file capability to a program using a simple API. The goal of libConfuse is not to be the configuration file parser library with a gazillion of features. Instead, it aims to be easy to use and quick to integrate with your code. libConfuse was called libcfg before, but was changed to not confuse with other similar libraries.

translations.zh-CN: libConfuse是一个配置文件解析器库,根据ISC许可证的条款获得许可,并用C写出. 它支持节和(列表)值(字符串,整数,浮点数,布尔克等),以及一些其他特性(如单/双引字符串,环境变量扩展,函数和嵌入包含语句等). 它使得使用简单的API将配置文件能力添加到一个程序中变得非常容易. libConfuse的目标不是成为配置文件解析器库,其特性为gazillion. 相反,它的目的是容易使用,并迅速与您的代码融合. libConfuse在之前被称为libcfg,但被修改为不会与其他类似的库相混淆.

It consists of the following parts: - A wrapper around fork() which does the correct daemonization procedure of a process - A wrapper around syslog() for simpler and compatible log output to Syslog or STDERR - An API for writing PID files - An API for serializing UNIX signals into a pipe for usage with select() or poll() - An API for running subprocesses with STDOUT and STDERR redirected to syslog APIs like these are used in most daemon software available. It is not that simple to get it done right and code duplication is not a goal.

translations.zh-CN: libdaemon是一个轻量级的 C 库,可以轻松地写出 UNIX 守护进程. 它由以下部分组成: - 一个绕叉()的包装器,它执行一个进程的正确守护进程 - 一个绕syslog()的包装器,用于向Syslog或STDERR提供更简单和相容的日志输出 - 一个API,用于写入PID文件 - 一个API,用于将UNIX信号序列化为一个管道,用于选择()或民意测验() - 一个API,用于运行带有STDUT和STDERR的子进程,这种Syslog API被重定向到大多数可用的守护进程软件中. 要做到正确不是那么简单,重复代码不是一个目标。

3161a3d4e2806019e7a464a3ce734eda54982d45.english: libmnl is a minimalistic user-space library oriented to Netlink developers. There are a lot of common tasks in parsing, validating, constructing of both the Netlink header and TLVs that are repetitive and easy to get wrong. This library aims to provide simple helpers that allows you to re-use code and to avoid re-inventing the wheel. The main features of this library are: . * Small: the shared library requires around 30KB for an x86-based computer. . * Simple: this library avoids complexity and elaborated abstractions that tend to hide Netlink details. . * Easy to use: the library simplifies the work for Netlink-wise developers. It provides functions to make socket handling, message building, validating, parsing and sequence tracking, easier. . * Easy to re-use: you can use the library to build your own abstraction layer on top of this library. . * Decoupling: the interdependency of the main bricks that compose the library is reduced, i.e. the library provides many helpers, but the programmer is not forced to use them.

translations.zh-CN: Libmnl是一个面向Netlink开发者的最小化用户-空间库. 在解析,验证,构建"Netlink"头和"TLV"上有很多常见的任务都是重复的,容易出错. 这个库旨在提供简单的帮助,使您能够重新使用代码并避免重出炉轮. 这个图书馆的主要功能是:. * 小:共享的图书馆需要30KB左右的基于x86的计算机. . *简单:这个库避免了复杂而细化的抽象,往往隐藏了Netlink的细节. . * 易用:库为Netlink-wise开发者简化了工作. 它提供功能,使套接字处理,消息构建,验证,解析和序列跟踪更加容易. . * 易再用: 您可以使用库来在本库上方自建抽象层. . *脱钩:构成图书馆的主要砖块的相互依存性被降低,即图书馆提供许多帮助,但程序员并不被迫使用.

dae295f35b1d06a15b695409d22161001a09f1b4.english: neon is an HTTP and WebDAV client library, with a C interface. Features: - High-level wrappers for common HTTP and WebDAV operations (GET, MOVE, DELETE, etc) - Low-level interface to the HTTP request/response engine, allowing the use of arbitrary HTTP methods, headers, etc. - Authentication support including Basic and Digest support, along with GSSAPI-based Negotiate on Unix, and SSPI-based Negotiate/NTLM on Win32 - SSL/TLS support using OpenSSL or GnuTLS; exposing an abstraction layer for verifying server certificates, handling client certificates, and examining certificate properties. Smartcard-based client certificates are also supported via a PKCS11 wrapper interface. - Abstract interface to parsing XML using libxml2 or expat, and wrappers for simplifying handling XML HTTP response bodies - WebDAV metadata support; wrappers for PROPFIND and PROPPATCH to simplify property manipulation.

translations.zh-CN: 霓虹是一款HTTP和WebDAV客户端库,有C接口. 特性: - 为常见的HTTP和WebDAV操作(GET,MOVE,DELETE等)提供高水平的包头-为HTTP请求/响应引擎提供低水平的接口,允许使用任意的HTTP方法,头等 - 认证支持,包括Basic和Digest支持,连同GSSAPI基于Unix的谈判,以及SSPI基于Win32上的SSL/NTLM支持 - 使用OpenSSL或GnuTLS的SSL/TLS支持;曝光一个抽象层来验证服务器证书,处理客户证书,并检查证书属性. 基于Smartcard的客户端证书也通过PKCS11包装器接口支持. - 使用 libxml2 或 expat 解析 XML 的抽象界面,以及用于简化处理 XML HTTP 响应机构的包装- WebDAV 元数据支持; PROPFIND 和 PROPPATCH 的包装以简化属性操纵.

930c95f53a5f8e05d5f5576a116020f7d1a2df76.english:
Enable JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler support.
Just-in-time compiling is a heavyweight optimization that can greatly
speed up pattern matching. However, it comes at the cost of extra
processing before the match is performed, so it is of most benefit when
the same pattern is going to be matched many times. This does not
necessarily mean many calls of a matching function; if the pattern is
not anchored, matching attempts may take place many times at various
positions in the subject, even for a single call. Therefore, if the
subject string is very long, it may still pay to use JIT even for
one-off matches. JIT support is available for all of the 8-bit, 16-bit
and 32-bit PCRE2 libraries and adds about 100KB to the resulting
libpcre2.so. JIT support applies only to the traditional Perl-compatible
matching function. It does not apply when the DFA matching function is
being used.
Enabling this option can give an about 10x performance increase on JIT
operations. It can be desireable for e.g. high performance Apache
mod_rewrite or HA-Proxy reqrep operations.
However, JIT should _only_ be enabled on architectures that are supported.
Enabling JIT on unsupported platforms will result in a compilation
failure. A list of supported architectures can be found here:
https://pcre.org/current/doc/html/pcre2jit.html#SEC2

7ed6e0a9dfec5b591cac1b2b1bb05d5e6c9008f9.english: NaCl (pronounced "salt") is a new easy-to-use high-speed software library for network communication, encryption, decryption, signatures, etc. NaCl's goal is to provide all of the core operations needed to build higher-level cryptographic tools. Sodium is a portable, cross-compilable, installable, packageable fork of NaCl (based on the latest released upstream version nacl-20110221), with a compatible API. The design choices, particularly in regard to the Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman function, emphasize security (whereas NIST curves emphasize "performance" at the cost of security), and "magic constants" in NaCl/Sodium have clear rationales. The same cannot be said of NIST curves, where the specific origins of certain constants are not described by the standards. And despite the emphasis on higher security, primitives are faster across-the-board than most implementations of the NIST standards.

translations.zh-CN: NaCl(发音为"盐")是一款新型易用高速软件库,用于网络通信,加密,解密,签名等. NaCl的目标是提供建造更高级密码工具所需的所有核心操作. Sodium是一种可移植,可交叉编译,可安装,可包装的NaCl分叉(基于最新发布的上游版nacl-20110221),有相容的API. 设计选择,特别是在Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman函数方面,强调安全性(因为NIST曲线以安全为代价强调"性能"),而"魔法常数"在NaCl/Sodium中有明确的理由. 28bf8a38c74d4f47cb2a9ab78ff2b29ca94c6ed8.english: Emailrelay is a simple SMTP proxy and store-and-forward message transfer agent (MTA). When running as a proxy all e-mail messages can be passed through a user-defined program, such as a spam filter, which can drop, re-address or edit messages as they pass through. When running as a store-and-forward MTA incoming messages are stored in a local spool directory, and then forwarded to the next SMTP server on request.

translations.zh-CN: Emailrelay是一个简单的SMTP代理并存储和转发消息传输代理(MTA). 在作为代理运行时,所有电子邮件消息都可以通过用户自定义的程序传递,如垃圾邮件过滤器,在消息通过时可以发送,重新处理或编辑. 在作为存储和转发的 MTA 消息运行时,存储在本地的 spool 目录中,然后根据请求转发到下一个 SMTP 服务器.

0c20b11907702c54e55e8d1e204dd7eb5831800c.english: Mesh11sd is a dynamic parameter configuration daemon for 802.11s mesh networks. It was originally designed to leverage 802.11s mesh networking at Captive Portal venues. This is the open source version and it enables easy and automated mesh network operation with multiple mesh nodes. It allows all mesh parameters supported by the wireless driver to be set in the uci config file. Settings take effect immediately without having to restart the wireless network. Default settings give rapid and reliable layer 2 mesh convergence. Without mesh11sd, many mesh parameters cannot be set in the uci wireless config file as the mesh interface must be up before the parameters can be set. Some of those that are supported, would fail to be implemented when the network is (re)started resulting in errors or dropped nodes. The mesh11sd daemon dynamically checks configured parameters and sets them as required. This version does not require a Captive Portal to be running.

8b9431d66bbead7138cee47ac5b6eed608f12b40.english: Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV), an extension to the HTTP-protocol, allows authoring of resources on a remote web server.davfs2 provides the ability to access such resources like a typical filesystem, allowing for use by standard applications with no built-in support for WebDAV. davfs2 is designed to fully integrate into the filesystem semantics of Unix-like systems (mount, umount, etc.). davfs2 makes mounting by unprivileged users as easy and secure as possible. davfs2 does extensive caching to make the file system responsive, to avoid unnecessary network traffic and to prevent data loss, and to cope for slow or unreliable connections. davfs2 will work with most WebDAV servers needing little or no configuration.

translations.zh-CN: Web Distribed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV),是HTTP-protocol的一个扩展,允许在远程网络服务器上编写资源. davfs2提供了像典型文件系统那样访问此类资源的能力,允许标准应用程序在没有内置支持WebDAV的情况下使用. davfs2旨在将Unix-like系统(mount,umount等)完全整合入文件系统语义. davfs2使非特权用户的安装尽可能容易和安全。 davfs2进行广泛的缓存,使文件系统响应,避免不必要的网络流量并预防数据丢失,并应对缓慢或不可靠的连接. davfs2将和大多数WebDAV服务器合作,只需要很少或没有配置.

cdd874ae90f413d6a6d97a0002c507cb45300c98.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS ftp server.

translations.zh-CN: OWFS是一套旨在使一线总线及其装置易于取用的程序. 其根本原则是创建虚拟文件系统,以独有的ID为目录,设备的单个属性被作为简单的文件来表示,可以读取并写出. 单个奴隶或主设计的细节被隐藏在一个一致的界面后. 目标是为软件设计师创建监测或控制应用程序提供一套简单的工具. 实施中有一些性能增强,包括数据缓存,平行访问总线主机,以及设备通信的汇总. 资金的目标仍然是便于使用、灵活和正确,而不是速度。 此软件包包含 OWFS ftp 服务器 。

96f743f1c170d1494248e449689aa3baa53bf97e.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS network server.

f2b1ac421c26d82ca3ea4fe1edaf2cb0e5bb6ec9.english: The ebtables program is a filtering tool for a bridging firewall. The filtering is focussed on the Link Layer Ethernet frame fields. Apart from filtering, it also gives the ability to alter the Ethernet MAC addresses and implement a brouter.

3d918c30596fd5701f3d269c354adf8d627b959b.english: Fwknop implements an authorization scheme known as Single Packet Authorization (SPA) for Linux systems running iptables.  This mechanism requires only a single encrypted and non-replayed packet to communicate various pieces of information including desired access through an iptables policy. The main application of this program is to use iptables in a default-drop stance to protect services such as SSH with an additional layer of security in order to make the exploitation of vulnerabilities (both 0-day and unpatched code) much more difficult. This package contains the fwknop client.

translations.zh-CN: Fwknop针对运行iptables的Linux系统执行名为"单包授权"(SPA)的授权方案. 这种机制只需要一个加密的、非重放的包就可以传递各种信息,包括通过iptables政策进行预期访问。 这个程序的主要应用是使用iptables在默认投放姿势中保护像SSH这样的具有多一层安全功能的服务,以便让利用弱点(包括0天和无标码)更加困难. 此包包含 fwknop 客户端 。

bdd8a68ee67e23bf2b594a537b228c641bfb7134.english: iptables extensions for matching cluster. Netfilter (IPv4/IPv6) module for matching cluster This option allows you to build work-load-sharing clusters of network servers/stateful firewalls without having a dedicated load-balancing router/server/switch. Basically, this match returns true when the packet must be handled by this cluster node. Thus, all nodes see all packets and this match decides which node handles what packets. The work-load sharing algorithm is based on source address hashing. This module is usable for ipv4 and ipv6. If you select it, it enables kmod-ipt-cluster. see `iptables -m cluster --help` for more information.

translations.zh-CN: 匹配集群的 iptables 扩展 。 网络过滤器( IPv4/ IPv6) 模块, 用于匹配集群 此选项允许您在没有专用负载平衡路由器/ 服务器/ 开关的情况下构建网络服务器/ 状态防火墙的工作负载共享集群 。 基本上, 当数据包必须由这个集群节点处理时, 此匹配返回为真实 。 因此,所有节点都能看到所有的数据包,这个匹配决定了哪个节点处理什么数据包. 工作负荷共享算法基于源地址散列. 这个模块可用于ipv4和ipv6. 如果您选中它, 它可以让 kmod-ipt-cluster. 查看 `iptables -m cluster --help` 获取更多信息 。

108f83eed63a7f846cd68e0b10eb8cc4fc6459ca.english: Avahi is an mDNS/DNS-SD (aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf) implementation (library). It facilitates service discovery on a local network -- this means that you can plug your laptop or computer into a network and instantly be able to view other people who you can chat with, find printers to print to or find files being shared. This kind of technology is already found in MacOS X (branded 'Rendezvous', 'Bonjour' and sometimes 'ZeroConf') and is very convenient. . This package implements IPv4LL, "Dynamic Configuration of IPv4 Link-Local Addresses" (IETF RFC3927), a protocol for automatic IP address configuration from the link-local 169.254.0.0/16 range without the need for a central server. It is primarily intended to be used in ad-hoc networks which lack a DHCP server.

It is similarly to the DHCP relay agent dhcrelay of ISC's DHCP, but has the following features which are important for me: - Runs as non-root in a chroot-jail - Uses "normal" AF_INET sockets; this allows to uses packetfilters to filter incoming messages. - The DHCP agent IDs can be defined freely - Has a small memory footprint when using dietlibc It tries to be RFC 2131/2132 and 3046 compliant. Probably it works with BOOTP (RFC 951) also, but since the handling of the giaddr field is described misleading (see RFC 1542), there may occur problems.

translations.zh-CN: 这个节目在具有不同子层广播域的子网间转发 DHCP 消息. 它与ISC的 DHCP 的 DHCP 中继代理 dhcrelay 类似,但具有以下对我很重要的特性: - 在chroot-jail 中作为非根运行 - 使用"正常"的 AF INET 套接字;这允许使用包过滤器来过滤收到的消息. - 说吧 DHCP 代理ID 可以自由定义 - 使用 Editerlibc 时有小的内存脚印 它试图遵守RFC 2131/2132和3046。 可能它也与BOOTP(RFC 951)合作,但由于Giadr场的处理被描述为误导(见RFC 1542),因此可能会出问题.

199a7c61314c6dda23694e7d1fcc797e20b19543.english:
With crypt(3) password storage scheme enabled, OpenLDAP can
receive and store SHA-256 and SHA-512 password hashes from
Samba AD-DC. If this option is disabled, synchronization of
passwords between Samba AD-DC (v4.5 and above) and OpenLDAP
requires use of cleartext passwords.
To enable crypt(3) password synchronization functionality:
1. Re-include crypt(3) support in OpenWRT by enabling 'Include
crypt() support for SHA256, SHA512 and Blowfish ciphers' option
in "Advanced configuration options (for developers)" ->
"Toolchain Options".
2. Provision AD-DC with 'password hash userPassword schemes'
option. For more information, see smb.conf manpage for details
on 'password hash userPassword schemes'.
3. Use a script to synchronize passwords from AD-DC to
OpenLDAP. See samba-tool manpage for 'user syncpasswords'.

translations.zh-CN:
启用密码(3) 密码存储方案后, OpenLDAP 可以
接收并存储 SHA-256 和 SHA-512 密码散列从
Samba AD-DC. (原始内容存档于2019-09-30). 如果禁用此选项, 则同步
Samba AD- DC( v4.5及以上) 和 OpenLDAP 之间的密码
需要使用清晰文本密码。
启用密码(3)密码同步功能:
1. 在 OpenWRT 中通过“ 插入” 重新包含密码(3) 支持
密码 () 支持 SHA256, SHA512 和 Blowfish 密码的选项
在“高级配置选项(适用于开发者)”中 ->
"工具链选项".
2. 提供AD-DC,配有“密码字散列用户Password计划”
选项。 详情见smb.conf manpage
(原始内容存档于2018-10-21). password plans.
3. 使用脚本将密码从AD-DC同步到
OpenLDAP (英语). 请参看“ 用户同步密码” 的 samba- tool manpage 。

74cd10d4b5ecd653150c9889e37c555b8d92e444.english: p910nd is a small daemon that copies any data received on the port it is listening on to the corresponding printer port. 815e5653ff534ece1c26528d22026beaa4975736.english: Babel is a loop-avoiding distance-vector routing protocol for IPv6 and IPv4 with fast convergence properties. It is based on the ideas in DSDV, AODV and Cisco's EIGRP, but is designed to work well not only in wired networks but also in wireless mesh networks, and has been extended with support for overlay networks. Babel is an IETF standard protocol (RFC 8966).

translations.zh-CN: Babel是IPv6和IPv4的环绕避去相距器路由协议,具有快趋同性能. 它基于DSDV,AODV和Cisco的EIGRP中的想法,但设计上不仅在有线网络中,而且在无线网网络中都有良好的效果,并在支持叠接网络的情况下被扩展. Babel是IETF标准协议(RFC 8966).

61a849386318d750c30c7893ab7a73e92bd3eb0e.english: A port of Cumulus BFD daemon to a more portable daemon. Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) is a network protocol that is used to detect faults between two forwarding engines connected by a link. It provides low-overhead detection of faults even on physical media that doesn't support failure detection of any kind, such as Ethernet, virtual circuits, tunnels and MPLS Label Switched Paths.

translations.zh-CN: Cumulus BFD守护进程移植到一个更便携式守护进程. 双向转发检测(BFD)是一种网络协议,用于检测通过链接连接的两个转发引擎之间的断层. 它提供即使是在物理介质上也不支持任何类型的故障检测的低高通断层检测,例如以太网,虚拟电路,地道和MPLS标签切换路径.

949172d641910fd5651d0251ad35baf3a9a1123c.english: Prince is an open source implementation of the PopRouting Algorithm. It has been developed as a Google Summer of Code Project in collaboration with Freifunk and the University of Trento. Prince fetches topology data from a Link State routing daemon (OONF, OLSR, OSPF, etc), calculates the betweenness centrality using the topology and then computes the the timers' optimal values using these data. At the end of the computation the timers are pushed back to the routing daemon. Since v0.4 it supports both OONF and OLSRd.

translations.zh-CN: Prince是PopRouting算法的开源执行. 它作为Google Summer of Code Project与弗赖福恩克和特伦托大学合作开发. Prince从 Link State 路由守护进程(OONF, OLSR, OSPF等)获取地形数据, 使用地形计算介质中心, 然后使用这些数据计算定时器的最佳值. 在计算结束时,计时器被推回到路由守护进程. 从v0.4起,它同时支持OONF和OLSRd.

Furthermore, in favor of Opus, other open-source audio codecs are no longer developed, like Speex, iSAC, iLBC, and Siren. If you use your Asterisk as a back-to-back user agent (B2BUA) and you transcode between various audio codecs, one should enable Opus for future compatibility. 4f3654df2a60b7f52f090e44c415531ac711e6b9.english: uAnytun is a tiny implementation of SATP the secure anycast tunneling protocol. SATP defines a protocol used for communication between any combination of unicast and anycast tunnel endpoints.  It has less protocol overhead than IPSec in Tunnel mode and allows tunneling of every ETHER TYPE protocol (e.g. ethernet, ip, arp ...). SATP directly includes cryptography and message authentication based on the methods used by SRTP.  It is intended to deliver a generic, scalable and secure solution for tunneling and relaying of packets of any protocol. Unlike Anytun which is a full featured implementation uAnytun has no support for multiple connections or synchronisation. It is a small single threaded implementation intended to act as a client on small platforms.

translations.zh-CN: uAnytun是SAP的微小执行 安全的任何播报隧道协议。 SATP定义了用于任何unicast和任意cast隧道端点的组合之间的通信的协议. 它在隧道模式下比IPSec协议的俯冲较少,并允许每个ETHER TYPE协议(如ethernet,ip,arp...)的隧道进行. SATP直接包括基于SRTP所使用的方法的加密和消息认证. 其目的是为任何协议包的隧道和中继提供通用、可扩展和安全的解决方案。 不同于 Anytun 是全功能执行 uAnytun 没有支持多个连接或同步 。 它是一个小的单一线性执行,旨在作为小平台上的客户端.

3e0e830a35132ee7f2a34c61550f83a070636a8d.english: WireGuard is a novel VPN that runs inside the Linux Kernel and utilizes state-of-the-art cryptography. It aims to be faster, simpler, leaner, and more useful than IPSec, while avoiding the massive headache. It intends to be considerably more performant than OpenVPN.  WireGuard is designed as a general purpose VPN for running on embedded interfaces and super computers alike, fit for many different circumstances. It uses UDP. This package provides the userspace control program for WireGuard, `wg(8)`, a netifd protocol helper, and a re-resolve watchdog script.

Use GnuTLS in place of OpenSSL for the core features of receiving
TLS connections from clients and making TLS connections to servers.
The GnuTLS support is still very much experimental and should be
tested before use.
SSL-Bump and certificate generation features are not yet supported
by GnuTLS builds. Nor are many other less commonly used Squid
TLS/SSL features.
squid.conf directives and configuration options which have undergone
name changes from 'ssl' to 'tls' prefix in Squid-4 have GnuTLS
support, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Advanced configuration with specific selection of ciphers and
similar settings should still work, but needs the GnuTLS Priority
Strings instead of the OpenSSL options when using GnuTLS.

TLS/SSL 特性.

25f72ae135598afa806512ad81e6447fb2a89251.english: alfred is a user space daemon for distributing arbitrary local information over the mesh/network in a decentralized fashion. This data can be anything which appears to be useful - originally designed to replace the batman-adv visualization (vis), you may distribute hostnames, phone books, administration information, DNS information, the local weather forecast ... alfred runs as daemon in the background of the system. A user may insert information by using the alfred binary on the command line, or use special programs to communicate with alfred (done via unix sockets). alfred then takes care of distributing the local information to other alfred servers on other nodes. This is done via IPv6 link-local multicast, and does not require any configuration. A user can request data from alfred, and will receive the information available from all alfred servers in the network.

translations.zh-CN: Alfred是一个用户空间守护进程,用于以分散的方式在网络/网络上发布任意的本地信息。 这些数据可以是任何看起来有用的东西—— 最初是用来取代蝙蝠侠- adv可视化( vis)的, 您可以在系统的背景中以守护进程的形式分发主机名, 电话簿, 管理信息, DNS 信息, 本地天气预报.  alfred runs as daemon 。 用户可以通过使用命令行上的alfred二进制插入信息,或者使用特殊程序与alfred(通过unix sockets)进行通信. 然后Alfred负责将本地信息分发给其他节点上的其他Alfred服务器. 这是通过IPv6链接-本地多播实现的,不需要任何配置. 一个用户可以请求Alfred提供数据,并将接收网络中所有Alfred服务器提供的信息.

8d06f76df119d572f0014a90df5ff4ef6873436c.english: Alarm Pinger (apinger) is a little tool which monitors various IP devices by simple ICMP echo requests. There are various other tools, that can do this, but most of them are shell or perl scripts, spawning many processes, thus much CPU-expensive, especially when one wants continuous monitoring and fast response on target failure.  Alarm Pinger is a single program written in C, so it doesn't need much CPU power even when monitoring many targets with frequent probes.  Alarm Pinger supports both IPv4 and IPv6. The code have been tested on Linux and FreeBSD.

translations.zh-CN: 提醒平格(apinger)是一个小工具,通过简单的ICMP回声请求来监测各种IP设备. 还有其他各种工具,可以做到这一点,但大多数工具是贝壳或perl脚本,孕育了许多过程,因此许多CPU-消耗性,特别是当人们想要对目标故障进行持续监测和快速响应时. 提醒平格(Almarm Pinger)是用C写成的单一程序,所以即使在频繁的探测器监视许多目标时,它也不需要太多的CPU功率. 提醒平格同时支持IPv4和IPv6. 该代码已经在Linux和FreeBSD上进行了测试.

As mtr starts, it investigates the network connection between the host mtr runs on and a user-specified destination host. After it determines the address of each network hop between the machines, it sends a sequence ICMP ECHO requests to each one to determine the quality of the link to each machine. As it does this, it prints running statistics about each machine.

translations.zh-CN: mtr 将“ traceroute”和“ ping”程序的功能结合在一个单一的网络诊断工具中。 随着mtr的开始,它调查主机mtr运行与用户指定的目的地主机之间的网络连接. 在它确定机器之间每个网络跳动的地址后,它会向每个机器发送一个序列ICMP ECHO请求以确定每个机器的链接质量. 它会打印每个机器的运行统计数据。

1a64ef6feb0824791f5467c2fea6aeb6fa991f8a.english: ndppd, or NDP Proxy Daemon, is a daemon that proxies NDP (Neighbor Discovery Protocol) messages between interfaces.  ndppd currently only supports Neighbor Solicitation Messages and Neighbor Advertisement Messages. The ndp_proxy provided by Linux doesn't support listing proxies, and only hosts are supported.  No subnets.  ndppd solves this by listening for Neighbor Solicitation messages on an interface, then query the internal interfaces for that target IP before finally sending a Neighbor Advertisement message.

cf808a924f888ede9fdfbbe87b233533b2e85924.english: Redsocks is a daemon running on the local system, that will transparently tunnel any TCP connection via a remote SOCKS4, SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy server. It uses the system firewall's redirection facility to intercept TCP connections, thus the redirection is system-wide, with fine-grained control, and does not depend on LD_PRELOAD libraries. Redsocks supports tunneling TCP connections and UDP packets. It has authentication support for both, SOCKS and HTTP proxies. Also included is a small DNS server returning answers with the "truncated" flag set for any UDP query, forcing the resolver to use TCP.

translations.zh-CN: Redsocks是一个运行在本地系统中的守护进程,它将通过远程的SOCKS4,SOCKS5或HTTP代理服务器透明地隧道任何TCP连接. 它使用系统防火墙的重定向设施拦截TCP连接,因此重定向是全系统的,具有精细的纹理控制,并不依赖于LD PRELOAD库. Redsocks支持隧道连接TCP和UDP包. 它对SOCKS和HTTP代理都有认证支持. 还包括一个小型的DNS服务器返回答案,上面设置了用于任何UDP查询的"truncted"旗号,迫使解析器使用TCP.

9a8286a67032470c8797df944c7d99304bf0490d.english: RRD is the Acronym for Round Robin Database. RRD is a system to store and display time-series data (i.e. network bandwidth, machine-room temperature, server load average). It stores the data in a very compact way that will not expand over time, and it presents useful graphs by processing the data to enforce a certain data density. It can be used either via simple wrapper scripts (from shell or Perl) or via frontends that poll network devices and put friendly user interface on it. This is version 1.0.x with cgilib-0.4, gd1.3 and libpng-1.0.9 linked into librrd.so. The library is much smaller compared to the 1.2.x version with separate dynamic linked libraries. This package contains the rrdcgi tool used to create web pages containing RRD graphs based on templates.

a24e9bcde58654175b6159b1a5cc8c3548c05157.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS fuse filesystem.

5b512ebfa5e58dc23f0902fe32374ce2d37397b7.english: This tool can be described as a Tiny, Dirty, Linux-and-OSX-Only C command that looks for coreutils basic commands (cp, mv, dd, tar, gzip/gunzip, cat, etc.) currently running on your system and displays the percentage of copied data. It can also show estimated time and throughput, and provide a "top-like" mode (monitoring). . It simply scans `/proc` for interesting commands, and then looks at directories `fd` and `fdinfo` to find opened files and seek positions, and reports status for the largest file. . It's very light, and compatible with virtually any command. This program was formerly known as 'cv' on github.

this does not protect array overflows via bad calls to the
{str,mem}*cpy() family of functions (that is addressed by
FORTIFY_SOURCE).

6f1a91e27446d129413a6f872f374bcf4563b3ee.english: On Sanitizer warnings, abort the running kernel code

01cb7dec5a1395a96ea6363042c4238c07d56aa8.english:
Building kernels with Sanitizer features enabled tends to grow the
kernel size by around 5%, due to adding all the debugging text on
failure paths. To avoid this, Sanitizer instrumentation can just
issue a trap. This reduces the kernel size overhead but turns all
warnings (including potentially harmless conditions) into full
exceptions that abort the running kernel code (regardless of context,
locks held, etc), which may destabilize the system. For some system
builders this is an acceptable trade-off.

fceeae85663323017aa58bfa8d49fffcf28966fd.english: Back mappings in vmalloc space with real shadow memory

75c57de75bc7f4230a3579b8db21eacde6ad9cc7.english:
By default, the shadow region for vmalloc space is the read-only
zero page. This means that KASAN cannot detect errors involving
vmalloc space.
Enabling this option will hook in to vmap/vmalloc and back those
mappings with real shadow memory allocated on demand. This allows
for KASAN to detect more sorts of errors (and to support vmapped
stacks), but at the cost of higher memory usage.
This option depends on HAVE_ARCH_KASAN_VMALLOC, but we can't
depend on that in here, so it is possible that enabling this
will have no effect.

17742fe078e2c9715e0e8d10fb2ae2695829c9db.english:
Enables Generic KASAN.
Consumes about 1/8th of available memory at kernel start and adds an
overhead of ~50% for dynamic allocations.
The performance slowdown is ~x3.

6d509c039969c5650d4e47df4f41f6377671ad8e.english:
Enables Software Tag-Based KASAN.
Supported only on arm64 CPUs and relies on Top Byte Ignore.
Consumes about 1/16th of available memory at kernel start and
add an overhead of ~20% for dynamic allocations.
May potentially introduce problems related to pointer casting and
comparison, as it embeds a tag into the top byte of each pointer.

fbe9c8d5c3a3e290c29b0e00e1ef0fc575cb8d50.english:
Enables Hardware Tag-Based KASAN.
Supported only on arm64 CPUs starting from ARMv8.5 and relies on
Memory Tagging Extension and Top Byte Ignore.
Consumes about 1/32nd of available memory.
May potentially introduce problems related to pointer casting and
comparison, as it embeds a tag into the top byte of each pointer.

f5dfaa62a12448569c2739201ff50beb8896e40a.english: Compile the kernel with pressure stall information tracking

f2a1ec9a71287a40e27701aa1e2647c899a0742b.english:
Collect metrics that indicate how overcommitted the CPU, memory,
and IO capacity are in the system.
If you say Y here, the kernel will create /proc/pressure/ with the
pressure statistics files cpu, memory, and io. These will indicate
the share of walltime in which some or all tasks in the system are
delayed due to contention of the respective resource.
In kernels with cgroup support, cgroups (cgroup2 only) will
have cpu.pressure, memory.pressure, and io.pressure files,
which aggregate pressure stalls for the grouped tasks only.
For more details see Documentation/accounting/psi.rst.
Say N if unsure.

74507a8ce47fe7f7ac14105ae812985aac7b912d.english: Tracer to detect hardware latencies (like SMIs)

5457339a09b733211258f4f3a0f8f7217c242b7b.english:
This tracer, when enabled will create one or more kernel threads,
depending on what the cpumask file is set to, which each thread
spinning in a loop looking for interruptions caused by
something other than the kernel. For example, if a
System Management Interrupt (SMI) takes a noticeable amount of
time, this tracer will detect it. This is useful for testing
if a system is reliable for Real Time tasks.
Some files are created in the tracing directory when this
is enabled:
hwlat_detector/width   - time in usecs for how long to spin for
hwlat_detector/window  - time in usecs between the start of each
iteration
A kernel thread is created that will spin with interrupts disabled
for "width" microseconds in every "window" cycle. It will not spin
for "window - width" microseconds, where the system can
continue to operate.
The output will appear in the trace and trace_pipe files.
When the tracer is not running, it has no affect on the system,
but when it is running, it can cause the system to be
periodically non responsive. Do not run this tracer on a
production system.
To enable this tracer, echo in "hwlat" into the current_tracer
file. Every time a latency is greater than tracing_thresh, it will
be recorded into the ring buffer.

37dd15d993d792d36349f288b2b22ea4aee749b4.english:
In the context of high-performance computing (HPC), the Operating
System Noise (osnoise) refers to the interference experienced by an
application due to activities inside the operating system. In the
context of Linux, NMIs, IRQs, SoftIRQs, and any other system thread
can cause noise to the system. Moreover, hardware-related jobs can
also cause noise, for example, via SMIs.
The osnoise tracer leverages the hwlat_detector by running a similar
loop with preemption, SoftIRQs and IRQs enabled, thus allowing all
the sources of osnoise during its execution. The osnoise tracer takes
note of the entry and exit point of any source of interferences,
increasing a per-cpu interference counter. It saves an interference
counter for each source of interference. The interference counter for
NMI, IRQs, SoftIRQs, and threads is increased anytime the tool
observes these interferences' entry events. When a noise happens
without any interference from the operating system level, the
hardware noise counter increases, pointing to a hardware-related
noise. In this way, osnoise can account for any source of
interference. At the end of the period, the osnoise tracer prints
the sum of all noise, the max single noise, the percentage of CPU
available for the thread, and the counters for the noise sources.
In addition to the tracer, a set of tracepoints were added to
facilitate the identification of the osnoise source.
The output will appear in the trace and trace_pipe files.
To enable this tracer, echo in "osnoise" into the current_tracer
file.

83643b7bf4f963e0f995c81155b624cd70358f30.english:
The timerlat tracer aims to help the preemptive kernel developers
to find sources of wakeup latencies of real-time threads.
The tracer creates a per-cpu kernel thread with real-time priority.
The tracer thread sets a periodic timer to wakeup itself, and goes
to sleep waiting for the timer to fire. At the wakeup, the thread
then computes a wakeup latency value as the difference between
the current time and the absolute time that the timer was set
to expire.
The tracer prints two lines at every activation. The first is the
timer latency observed at the hardirq context before the
activation of the thread. The second is the timer latency observed
by the thread, which is the same level that cyclictest reports. The
ACTIVATION ID field serves to relate the irq execution to its
respective thread execution.
The tracer is build on top of osnoise tracer, and the osnoise:
events can be used to trace the source of interference from NMI,
IRQs and other threads. It also enables the capture of the
stacktrace at the IRQ context, which helps to identify the code
path that can cause thread delay.

0df94ac1269123f91832c4917e0e17f0b94cfbb4.english:
Hist triggers allow one or more arbitrary trace event fields to be
aggregated into hash tables and dumped to stdout by reading a
debugfs/tracefs file. They're useful for gathering quick and dirty
(though precise) summaries of event activity as an initial guide for
further investigation using more advanced tools.
Inter-event tracing of quantities such as latencies is also
supported using hist triggers under this option.

40f3f80516938ed8fba826a81851269840784aca.english:
Generate BPF Type Format (BTF) information from DWARF debug info.
Turning this on expects presence of pahole tool, which will convert
DWARF type info into equivalent deduplicated BTF type info.
Required to run BPF CO-RE applications.

a7feacd2b5fc102a80235d0ef354dda0c1471d82.english: Allow loading modules with non-matching BTF type info

fc08696c153c7c79ee5ea19efe56d334cee27c76.english:
For modules whose split BTF does not match vmlinux, load without
BTF rather than refusing to load. The default behavior with
module BTF enabled is to reject modules with such mismatches;
this option will still load module BTF where possible but ignore
it when a mismatch is found.

b0c610521257fdb4dc9b17e7718992fce9f77f17.english:
If you say Y here gcc is instructed to generate less debugging
information for structure types. This means that tools that
need full debugging information (like kgdb or systemtap) won't
be happy. But if you merely need debugging information to
resolve line numbers there is no loss. Advantage is that
build directory object sizes shrink dramatically over a full
DEBUG_INFO build and compile times are reduced too.
Only works with newer gcc versions.

6c74e09eee37f81650a6d61bad885dc2ff877ae3.english:

84168462ade62d36a5eae62e3591691f58c0af01.english: Compile the kernel with BPF event support

4851913aa93db2f5d2caa5ffd2b2dd9eb31a8f1b.english:

a3e1398000b69b735b7f5dae126b52210086d18f.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Allow a TCP stream parser to be used with BPF_MAP_TYPE_SOCKMAP.

5a94d2b1465df51d14bacb6426114d23bc7db744.english:

0415e6834176d7e19c1082cf84e327d3464b5906.english: Allocate a PMD sized folio for zeroing

6bfddc885909bb1e8b1d0810b2dac514b15f2ba7.english:
Enable this option to reduce the runtime refcounting overhead
of the huge zero folio and expand the places in the kernel
that can use huge zero folios. For instance, block I/O benefits
from access to large folios for zeroing memory.
With this option enabled, the huge zero folio is allocated
once and never freed. One full huge page's worth of memory shall
be used.
Say Y if your system has lots of memory. Say N if you are
memory constrained.

2eda947532b98e106a263940bc9c06ee2eba8f5b.english:
Do not maintain per-page mapcounts for pages part of larger
allocations, such as transparent huge pages.
When this config option is enabled, some interfaces that relied on
this information will rely on less-precise per-allocation information
instead: for example, using the average per-page mapcount in such
a large allocation instead of the per-page mapcount.
EXPERIMENTAL because the impact of some changes is still unclear.

a0b0ad8103559e1fe93c3e78d91c27767505179b.english: Compile the kernel with Contiguous PTE mappings for user memory

df4dd1ed9fcccb91d749f0d8191f945db6932438.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with Contiguous PTE mappings for user memory.

fb2aedaa806d2c8f0dc527c2f44fd7b54b304464.english: Compile the kernel with detect Hard Lockups

435be93ab4ae2a20b37f0133ae00d35a21791755.english:
Say Y here to enable the kernel to act as a watchdog to detect

Hardlockups are bugs that cause the CPU to loop in kernel mode
for more than 10 seconds, without letting other interrupts have a
chance to run.  The current stack trace is displayed upon detection
and the system will stay locked up.

1b016fecbe9371bbd305a5ad943e7278dbdf7d30.english:

Enabling this can result in a significant increase of code size.

b74c5b2d7d7a431bfbbd0df250fe116c300849f1.english: Boot kernel with basic caches debugging enabled

70415ba9f894d914c3c319c7760575ca0b768a41.english:

341b1f587565b97af05bc1ae7ed5a7f5a72d6bc3.english:
Legacy cgroup v1 cpusets controller which has been deprecated by

which haven't migrated to the new cgroup v2 interface yet. If you
do not have any such application then you are completely fine leaving

75a7eb2e1d4b253413a564b2d6edee442f1a2457.english:
Legacy cgroup v1 memory controller which has been deprecated by
cgroup v2 implementation. The v1 is there for legacy applications
which haven't migrated to the new cgroup v2 interface yet. If you
do not have any such application then you are completely fine leaving

Please note that feature set of the legacy memory controller is likely
going to shrink due to deprecation process. New deployments with v1
controller are highly discouraged.

e0647162553129949fb6477d36c6389a1d691106.english:
This module provides glue between core networking code and device
drivers to support L3 master devices like VRF.
Increases the compressed kernel size by ~4kB (as of Linux 6.6).

35cf267d4dbeb41b4ddbb056fe919c70c9be4f28.english:
This enables support for configuring Data Center Bridging (DCB)
features on DCB capable Ethernet adapters via rtnetlink.  Say 'Y'
if you have a DCB capable Ethernet adapter which supports this
interface and you are connected to a DCB capable switch.
DCB is a collection of Ethernet enhancements which allow DCB capable
NICs and switches to support network traffic with differing
requirements (highly reliable, no drops vs. best effort vs. low
latency) to co-exist on Ethernet.
DCB features include:
Enhanced Transmission Selection (aka Priority Grouping) - provides a
framework for assigning bandwidth guarantees to traffic classes.
Priority-based Flow Control (PFC) - a MAC control pause frame which
works at the granularity of the 802.1p priority instead of the
link (802.3x).

733de9a762f67fe61d75497db8fd36a89e9e9f8e.english:
XDP sockets allows a channel between XDP programs and
userspace applications.

c3cf86036abfc9d1dd6ebe31adfac1d698a8d67a.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Page pool stats support.

8cdb3e4ac321066b8e3c2b192cf1710bf91045fe.english:

Increases the compressed kernel size by ~214kB (as of Linux 6.6).

39e2b5ab1b234826ffda3c631dd33e1ae1d2d49e.english: OpenWrt configuration option: IPv6 support for Multipath TCP.

2c32b4ab5bba17fc8b302841b2c81e5ec1695aa2.english:

b57d310797d2662678d02279feb0e56abc4d667f.english: OpenWrt configuration option: EROFS Security Labels.

d4de7b517f53106a2fbaab68dfe0c89e6c156d70.english:
A kernel build should not cause any compiler warnings, and this
enables the '-Werror' (for C) and '-Dwarnings' (for Rust) flags
to enforce that rule by default. Certain warnings from other tools
such as the linker may be upgraded to errors with this option as
well.
However, if you have a new (or very old) compiler or linker with odd
and unusual warnings, or you have some architecture with problems,
you may need to disable this config option in order to
successfully build the kernel.

0bc3f324ac4aaaa6856b72d3aca3e1e237969913.english:
This is the traditional Linux preemption model, geared towards
throughput. It will still provide good latencies most of the
time, but there are no guarantees and occasional longer delays
are possible.
Select this option if you are building a kernel for a server or
scientific/computation system, or if you want to maximize the
raw processing power of the kernel, irrespective of scheduling
latencies.

4aeb6d82394bd5dc300d241552440acb2963cbdc.english:
This option reduces the latency of the kernel by adding more
"explicit preemption points" to the kernel code. These new
preemption points have been selected to reduce the maximum
latency of rescheduling, providing faster application reactions,
at the cost of slightly lower throughput.
This allows reaction to interactive events by allowing a
low priority process to voluntarily preempt itself even if it
is in kernel mode executing a system call. This allows
applications to run more 'smoothly' even when the system is
under load.
Select this if you are building a kernel for a desktop system.

09cbe1565ca20d2b506ab9b921ec5245cd932db2.english:
This option reduces the latency of the kernel by making
all kernel code (that is not executing in a critical section)
preemptible.  This allows reaction to interactive events by
permitting a low priority process to be preempted involuntarily
even if it is in kernel mode executing a system call and would
otherwise not be about to reach a natural preemption point.
This allows applications to run more 'smoothly' even when the
system is under load, at the cost of slightly lower throughput
and a slight runtime overhead to kernel code.
Select this if you are building a kernel for a desktop or
embedded system with latency requirements in the milliseconds
range.

b84d48705008498493cada7164e7033502e900b7.english:
This option turns the kernel into a real-time kernel by replacing
various locking primitives (spinlocks, rwlocks, etc.) with
preemptible priority-inheritance aware variants, enforcing
interrupt threading and introducing mechanisms to break up long
non-preemptible sections. This makes the kernel, except for very
low level and critical code paths (entry code, scheduler, low
level interrupt handling) fully preemptible and brings most
execution contexts under scheduler control.
Select this if you are building a kernel for systems which
require real-time guarantees.

88a5a4cc10b5383128f67e17150d1e19c0938ffa.english: Dead code and data elimination for all packages (EXPERIMENTAL)

4a2211eeaaf2c072815e2e9b4809287e2ca595cc.english:

c4766987e8aee2dc99d058a2f93f1fdb8d6d1ba9.english:
